evidenceBoundary.exact: Complete pdata/chained windows of the anonymous optimized reader and metadata-named BeyondReadString, plus the shared lookup helper.
evidenceBoundary.direct: On the pool-present branch, both consume an Int32 index, return the same empty-string literal for -1 and null for -2, and tail-forward the remaining index and identical pool instance to the same lookup helper.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Selected initialized pool-present branch, compatible reader and pool, sufficient buffered index bytes and normal helpers. Pool-absent behavior and live pool selection are not admitted.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: This proves a string-valued read, not inline MemoryPack string wire compatibility or current corpus admission.

keyPaths.valueTransfer: Pooled string RAX bits stored to the same wrapper +16; matching reference barrier destination in RCX.
keyPaths.condition: Initialized metadata, positive one-member header, valid disjoint reader/wrapper storage and normal nonthrowing allocator/barrier ABI. Null/malformed headers and live formatter selection are excluded.

keyPaths.valueTransfer: Pooled string RAX bits stored to the same wrapper +16; matching reference barrier destination in RCX.
keyPaths.condition: Initialized metadata, positive one-member header, valid disjoint reader/wrapper storage and normal nonthrowing allocator/barrier ABI. Null/malformed headers and live formatter selection are excluded.

value.result: Same eight output bytes returned in RAX

peek.result: AL iff next byte is FF; reader unchanged

readNull.result: Non-FF byte remains unconsumed; AL zero

positive.output: Unchanged GetValue RAX stored as QWORD

forward.selection: normal initialization calls preserve saved reader/output and valid matched frame; default concrete formatter selected

invoke.condition: Incoming selector low16 is five; valid ready receiver/class with original selected slot callback and MethodInfo, normal preparation ABI, stable disjoint storage and nonthrowing callback. Runtime receiver/MethodInfo binding and inlined alternatives remain separate.

canonicalAdapter.boundary: Matching registration rows and physical pointers only; folded aliases, null pointers and duplicate rows remain explicit. No unique body identity, runtime context selection or callee effects follow.

evidenceBoundary.direct: Typed four-member Param, one-member EventArgsPtr pooled key, exact selected caller/dispatch/forwarder/GetValue transfers, null parent output, current static registration and wrapper ownership.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Initialized coherent closed contexts and ready classes; selected compatible generated adapter, wrapper formatter and conversion slots; normal nonabstract typed wrapper activation, allocation/barrier/helper ABI and sufficient contiguous input.
